title: KBO Player Dataset (1982-2025)
author: netsong
upstream_origin: STATIZ web-scraped data as stated by the dataset author
known_limitations: 2026 is not included in this dataset.
The mirror page warns that 2022-2025 may need supplementation.
Players with both hitting and pitching records may contain only their primary-position record.
A traded player can have more than one team row in a season; this dashboard retains the Hanwha row only.
